issues.issue: Trial name labels the cIAI trial as a single pooled study 'CXA-cIAI-10-08&09', but the design/N/result citations (979 randomized, MITT 806) come from a single trial (line 279/284), while the pooled-table citation (line 724) describes 988 randomized / 790 MITT — the text conflates a pooled trial with single-trial efficacy numbers.

The N text cites 979 randomized and MITT 806 (389/417) from line 279/281/284, which are single-trial numbers, yet the trial_name claims this entry is the pooled CXA-cIAI-10-08&09 analysis (988 randomized/790 MITT) — internally inconsistent N figures.

Result states 'meeting non-inferiority' and the 95% CI is -9.2 to 0.7, which crosses zero; non-inferiority depends on the pre-specified margin (not stated in the citations), so the margin/basis for declaring NI is not supported by the quotes provided.

Trial name claims cUTI efficacy is 'pooled from CXA-cUTI-10-04 and CXA-cUTI-10-05', but the N/result citations (1068 randomized, mMITT 800) are from a single trial (line 293/294/299), not a pooled analysis — same conflation problem as the cIAI entry.

The endpoint citation quote is tagged to line 293 (the design/population line), which appears to be a mis-referenced line; the primary endpoint definition text does not match the line-293 design quote used elsewhere.

Basis text adds 'under GAIN/FDASIA' which is not present in the citation quote ('As ceftolozane-tazobactam has QIDP designation, it received a priority review.'); the GAIN/FDASIA attribution exceeds the quote.
Summary states priority review was 'under GAIN'; the cited quote does not mention GAIN, so this claim is slightly beyond the citation support.
False-positive note: first_cycle_approval=true is correctly defaulted (no prior CRL in crl_history and approval letter shows completed review); not an issue.
